qualifications.item: Extensive real-world customer experiences in enterprise architecture and global infrastructures.
Creative problem solver with know how to get things done and ability to lead others to success.
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop easy rapport with others while building trust.
Success driven, passionate, and committed to excellence, high standards, and customer satisfaction.

work.item: Served as the trusted technical advisor to enterprise retail customers, translating business goals into cloud roadmaps.
Planned and led cloud migration and modernization programs from assessment through zero-downtime cutover.
Aligned stakeholders across customer, partner and internal service teams to clear blockers and keep programs on schedule.
Brought newly acquired brands onto shared platforms, consolidating vendors and reducing infrastructure spend.
Drove adoption of AI developer tools through enablement and workshops, growing usage across engineering teams.
Led disaster-recovery planning and operational reviews to improve workload resilience.
Maintained a current view of the market dynamics and competitive landscape to ensure the Product Marketing team stays ahead in this ever-changing world.
Established and leveraged an internal and external network of subject matter experts to develop competitive positioning against a diverse set of competitors.
Led a small team that helped turn strategies and evidence of our superiority to competitors into materials that would be helpful for the customer facing teams selling our products.
Held multiple SME roles, learning what to improve across products and how best practices vary by industry.
Created interim solutions until features were productized, keeping a 100% renewal rate on my accounts.
Assisted multi-million dollar deals with solution architecture, demos and complex proofs of concept, driving Code42 product selection and CrashPlan revenue.
Liaised between Code42 Product Management, Information Experience, Sales, Development, and strategic partners to continuously influence product design and messaging.
Successfully de-escalate frustrated clients effectively increasing comfort, trust and program visibility.
Monitored cloud services and appliances with observability tools such as Zabbix.
Successfully grew premium service from 10 pilot users to 3K+ franchised financial advisors.
Designed and implemented campus-wide Windows 7 migration tool streamlining performance and reducing cost.
Provided on-site and remote hardware and software support and implemented leading edge end-user systems.
Provided basic planning and design of key enterprise systems and performed maintenance.
Developed new business portals around MVC approach.
Performed code reviews, software upgrades and implementations, and database admin tasks.
